# Reference vectors for the three routers in kernels-metal/kernels/moe/route.metal.
# produced by crates/driver-metal/tests/fixtures/cuda_reference.cu (regenerate with run.sh beside it)
# gpu: NVIDIA L40S, sm_89
# nvcc: 13.0.88
# built: Aug 25 2026
#
# Arrays are named for the CUDA kernel's own parameters, IN LOWER CASE: a name in this
# format is [a-z0-9_], so `I`, `K`, `E`, `R` and `C` are written `i`, `k`, `e`, `r` and `c`.
# Every f32 token is the little-endian bit pattern of the value; a bf16 operand is recorded
# as the f32 its sixteen bits widen to, so the Metal side loads the same bits after narrowing.
# A scalar is an array of length 1.
#
# topk_softmax_block     <- pie::moe::topk_softmax<bf16>(logits, null, null, topk_idx, topk_w, num_experts=40, K=6, hidden=0)
# topk_softmax_warp      <- pie::moe::topk_softmax_warp_x2<bf16>(logits, topk_idx, topk_w, num_experts=40, K=6) -- SAME logits
# topk_sigmoid_renorm    <- pie::moe::topk_sigmoid<bf16>(logits, topk_idx, topk_w, bias=null, E=40, K=6, renormalize=1, routed_scaling_factor=2.5)
# topk_sigmoid_plain     <- the same, renormalize=0, routed_scaling_factor=1.5
# topk_sigmoid_fanout    <- the same at E=5, K=8: K > E, so the spare slots park on expert 0 at weight 0
# topk_sqrtsoftplus_bias <- pie::moe::topk_sqrtsoftplus<bf16>(logits, topk_idx, topk_w, correction_bias, E=40, K=6, renormalize=1, routed_scaling_factor=1)
# topk_sqrtsoftplus_plain<- the same with a zero bias, renormalize=0, routed_scaling_factor=1.5
#
# The block form is 1 block of 64 threads per row (moe.rs::router_lane); the warp form 1 block of 32;
# the two ranked routers 1 block of 256 (moe.rs::rms).
#
# BOTH softmax cases are route.metal's `softmax_over_all == 0` arm -- a softmax over the
# SELECTED k. topk_softmax renormalises the full softmax over its K and topk_softmax_warp_x2
# exponentiates only the K, which is how router_topk spells it; the two agree to f32 rounding.
# route.metal's `softmax_over_all != 0` arm has NO CUDA twin and is not covered here.
# router_topk_sigmoid has no correction bias, so topk_sigmoid is driven with a null one.
#
